position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 147.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; The SBA&#8217;s function is to protect the interests of small<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.62pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 159.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.1pt;">businesses. The SBA classifies a small business as a business that is organized for profit and is independently owned and<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.46pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 171.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.18pt;">operating primarily within the United States with less than $15 million in tangible net worth and not more than $5<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.54pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 183.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.24pt;">million in average after-tax net income. The SBA supports small businesses by administering several programs that<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 219.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.63pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; Individual transactions can differ markedly in both<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.54pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 588.96pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.25pt;">structure and execution. Interest not paid in cash will generally be capitalized and added to the outstanding<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.64pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 75.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.14pt;">principal balance of the related security. Deferral of interest through such capitalization will reduce the yield on such<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 21.94pt;">ABS.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; white-space: pre; width: 485.23pt;">structural risks and legal risks. Credit risk arises from (i) losses due to defaults by obligors under the underlying<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.59pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 135.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.23pt;">collateral and (ii) the issuing vehicle&#8217;s or servicer&#8217;s failure to perform their respective obligations under the transaction<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.59pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 147.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.14pt;">documents governing the ABS. These two risks may be related, as, for example, in the case of a servicer that does not<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.5pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 159.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 437.19pt;">provide adequate credit-review scrutiny to the underlying collateral, leading to a higher incidence of defaults.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 183.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.2pt;">Market risk arises from the cash flow characteristics of the ABS, which for most ABS tend to be predictable. The<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.56pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 195.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.14pt;">greatest variability in cash flows come from credit performance, including the presence of wind-down or acceleration<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.5pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 207.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 469.38pt;">features designed to protect the investor in the event that credit losses in the portfolio rise well above expected levels.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 231.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.16pt;">Interest rate risk arises for the issuer from (i) the pricing terms on the underlying collateral, (ii) the terms of the interest<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.52pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 243.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.26pt;">rate paid to holders of the ABS and (iii) the need to mark to market the excess servicing or spread account proceeds<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.62pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 255.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.22pt;">carried on the issuing vehicle&#8217;s balance sheet. For the holder of the security, interest rate risk depends on the expected<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.58pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 267.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.26pt;">life of the ABS, which may depend on prepayments on the underlying assets or the occurrence of wind-down or<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.62pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 279.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.24pt;">termination events. If the servicer becomes subject to financial difficulty or otherwise ceases to be able to carry out its<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.6pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 291.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.19pt;">functions, it may be difficult to find other acceptable substitute servicers and cash flow disruptions or losses may occur,<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.55pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 303.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.25pt;">particularly with underlying collateral comprised of non-standard receivables or receivables originated by private<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.61pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 315.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 230.8pt;">retailers who collect many of the payments at their stores.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 339.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.26pt;">Structural and legal risks include the possibility that, in a bankruptcy or similar proceeding involving the originator or<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.62pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; top: 351.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.19pt;">the servicer (often the same entity or affiliates), a court having jurisdiction over the proceeding could determine that,<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.55pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 363.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.26pt;">because of the degree to which cash flows on the assets of the issuing vehicle may have been commingled with cash<span style="display: inline-block; top: 375.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.16pt;">flows on the originator&#8217;s other assets (or similar reasons), (i) the assets of the issuing vehicle could be treated as never<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.52pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 399.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.22pt;">originator, or (ii) the transfer of such assets to the issuer could be voided as a fraudulent transfer. The time and expense<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; Consequently, changes in interest rates,<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.49pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 363.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.23pt;">particularly short-term interest rates, may significantly influence our net income. Increases in these rates will tend to<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; Periodic interest rate caps limit the<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.49pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 447.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.17pt;">amount an interest rate can increase during any given period. Lifetime interest rate caps limit the amount an interest rate<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.53pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 459.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.14pt;">can increase through maturity of a loan. Our borrowings, including our repurchase agreement and securitizations, are not<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.5pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 471.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.14pt;">subject to similar restrictions. Accordingly, in a period of rapidly increasing interest rates, the interest rates paid on our<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.5pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 483.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.19pt;">borrowings could increase without limitation while interest rate caps would limit the interest rates on our floating rate<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.55pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 495.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.12pt;">mortgage loans. As a result, we could receive less cash income on floating rate<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.53pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 531.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.21pt;">mortgage loans than we need to pay interest on our related borrowings. These factors could lower our net interest income<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; In accordance with<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.56pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 627.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.27pt;">accounting rules, we will be required to reduce our earnings for any decrease in the fair market value of our assets that<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.63pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 639.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.16pt;">are accounted for under the fair value option. We will be required to evaluate our assets on a quarterly basis to determine<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.52pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 651.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.25pt;">their fair value by using third-party bid price indications provided by dealers who make markets in these assets or by<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.61pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 663.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.12pt;">third-party pricing services. If the fair value of an asset is not available from a dealer or third-party pricing service, we<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.48pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 675.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.14pt;">will estimate the fair value of the asset using a variety of methods, including discounted cash flow analysis, matrix<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.5pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 687.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.26pt;">pricing, option-adjusted spread models and fundamental analysis. Aggregate characteristics taken into consideration<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.62pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 699.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.25pt;">include type of collateral, index, margin, periodic cap, lifetime cap, underwriting standards, age and delinquency<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.61pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 711.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.15pt;">experience. However, the fair value reflects estimates and may not be indicative of the amounts we would receive in a<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.51pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div></div></div><div style="--justify: justify; --position: absolute; background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #CCCC; content-visibility: auto; float: none; font-family: Arial, Sans Serif; font-size: 0; height: 792pt; margin: 10px auto 10px auto; overflow: hidden; padding: 0; position: relative; width: 612pt; word-wrap: break-word;"><div style="left: 0pt; position: var(--position); top: 728.64pt;"><div style="width: 485pt;"><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); top: 27.28pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 301pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre;">36<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div></div></div><div style="left: 0pt; position: var(--position); top: 0pt;"><div style="width: 485pt;"></div></div><div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 63.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.24pt;">current market exchange. For example, the federal Home<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; Although both over-the-counter and<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; white-space: pre; width: 485.23pt;">regulated market and cleared through a central counterparty. Unlike uncleared swaps, the counterparty for the cleared<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.59pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 471.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.24pt;">swaps is the clearing house, which reduces counterparty risk. However, cleared swaps require us to appoint clearing<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.6pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 483.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.22pt;">brokers and to post margin in accordance with the clearing house&#8217;s rules, which has resulted in increased costs for<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.58pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 495.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.28pt;">cleared swaps over uncleared swaps. Regulators have also mandated margin requirements with respect to uncleared<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.64pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 507.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 143.86pt;">swaps under certain circumstances.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 207.22000000000003pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 3.48pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 210.7pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 337.94pt;">These rules&#160;require us to post margin for uncleared swaps with swap dealers. The<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.64pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 519.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.24pt;">margin for both cleared and uncleared swaps will generally be limited to cash and certain types of securities. These<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.6pt; The amount of such discount will nevertheless generally be treated as &#8220;market discount&#8221; for U.S.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.59pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 531.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.11pt;">federal income tax purposes. Market discount generally accrues on the basis of the constant yield to maturity of the debt<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.47pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 543.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.24pt;">instrument based generally on the assumption that all future payments on the debt instrument will be made. Accrued<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.6pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 555.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.26pt;">market discount is reported as income when, and to the extent that, any payment of principal of the debt instrument is<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.62pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 567.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.15pt;">made. In particular, payments on mortgage loans are ordinarily made monthly, and consequently accrued market<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.51pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 579.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.27pt;">discount may have to be included in income each month as if the debt instrument were assured of ultimately being<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.63pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 591.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.15pt;">collected in full. position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.26pt;">would in general ultimately have an offsetting loss deduction available to us when such interest was determined to be<span style="display: inline-block; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 111.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 197.74pt;">having capital gain in that later year or thereafter.<span style="display: inline-block; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.25pt;">We may hold excess MSRs, which means the portion of an MSR that exceeds the arm&#8217;s-length fee for services<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.61pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; Based on IRS guidance concerning the classification of MSRs, we intend to treat<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.53pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 159.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.21pt;">any excess MSRs we acquire as ownership interests in the interest payments made on the underlying mortgage loans,<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.5699999999999pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 171.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.21pt;">akin to an &#8220;interest only&#8221; strip. Under this treatment, for purposes of determining the amount and timing of taxable<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.5699999999999pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 183.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.24pt;">income, each excess MSR is treated as a bond that was issued with OID on the date we acquired such excess MSR. In<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.6pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 195.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.17pt;">general, we will be required to accrue OID based on the constant yield to maturity of each excess MSR, and to treat such<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.53pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 207.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.11pt;">OID as taxable income in accordance with the applicable U.S. federal income tax rules. The constant yield of an excess<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.47pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 219.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.19pt;">MSR will be determined, and we will be taxed, based on a prepayment assumption regarding future payments due on the<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.55pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 231.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.2pt;">mortgage loans underlying the excess MSR. If the mortgage loans underlying an excess MSR prepay at a rate different<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.56pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 243.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.18pt;">than that under the prepayment assumption, our recognition of OID will be either increased or decreased depending on<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.54pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 255.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.14pt;">the circumstances. Thus, in a particular taxable year, we may be required to accrue an amount of income in respect of an<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.5pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 267.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.21pt;">excess MSR that exceeds the amount of cash collected in respect of that excess MSR. Furthermore, it is possible that,<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.5699999999999pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 279.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.17pt;">over the life of the investment in an excess MSR, the total amount we pay for, and accrue with respect to, the excess<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.53pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 291.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.22pt;">MSR may exceed the total amount we collect on such excess MSR. No assurance can be given that we will be entitled to<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; white-space: pre; width: 449.03pt;">The interest apportionment rules may affect our ability to comply with the REIT asset and gross income tests.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.77pt;"></span><span id="i075fad3f1b8a4213bd786a592cdeefec"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.14pt;">security based on a fraction, the numerator of which is the value of the real property securing the loan, determined when<span style="display: inline-block; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.2pt;">face amount of the loan, despite the Code&#8217;s requirement that taxpayers treat any market discount, which is the difference<span style="display: inline-block; We seek to mitigate this risk by seeking to acquire assets at appropriate prices given<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.62pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 351.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.17pt;">anticipated and unanticipated losses and by deploying a value-driven approach to underwriting and diligence, consistent<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.53pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 363.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.24pt;">with our historical investment strategy, with a focus on projected cash flows and potential risks to cash flow. We further<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.6pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 375.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.13pt;">mitigate our risk of potential losses while managing and servicing our loans by performing various workout and loss<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.49pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 387.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.18pt;">mitigation strategies with delinquent borrowers. The amount of this exposure is the<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; Those standards require that we plan and<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.47pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 387.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.15pt;">perform the audit to obtain reasonable assurance about whether effective internal control over financial reporting was<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.51pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 399.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.26pt;">maintained in all material respects. Our audit included obtaining an understanding of internal control over financial<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; white-space: pre; width: 485.15pt;">of internal control based on the assessed risk, and performing such other procedures as we considered necessary in the<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 435.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; We believe that our audit provides a reasonable basis for our opinion.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 307pt;">Definition and Limitations of Internal Control over Financial Reporting<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.77pt;"></span><span id="ic0c38c4235644d57a0e6892304125a49"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 483.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.2pt;">A company&#8217;s internal control over financial reporting is a process designed to provide reasonable assurance regarding<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.56pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 495.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.27pt;">the reliability of financial reporting and the preparation of financial statements for external purposes in accordance with<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.63pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 507.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.2pt;">generally accepted accounting principles. A company&#8217;s internal control over financial reporting includes those policies<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.56pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 519.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.25pt;">and procedures that (1) pertain to the maintenance of records that, in reasonable detail, accurately and fairly reflect the<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.61pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 531.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.15pt;">transactions and dispositions of the assets of the company; (2) provide reasonable assurance that transactions are<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.51pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 543.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.27pt;">recorded as necessary to permit preparation of financial statements in accordance with generally accepted accounting<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.63pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); white-space: pre; width: 485.13pt;">principles, and that receipts and expenditures of the company are being made only in accordance with authorizations of<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.54pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none;
