The dollar amount each party pays is an agreed-upon periodic interest rate multiplied by a pre-<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 317.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.26pt;">determined dollar principal (notional amount). No principal (notional amount) is exchanged between the two parties at<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.62pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 329.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.27pt;">the trade initiation date and only interest payments are exchanged over the life of the contract. The fair value adjustments<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.63pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 341.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.28pt;">are reported within net unrealized gain (loss) on financial instruments, while the related interest income or interest<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.64pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 353.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.24pt;">expense are reported within net realized gain (loss) on financial instruments in the consolidated statements of operations.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.6pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 365.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 142.56pt;">Interest rate swaps are classified as <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 205.92000000000002pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 30.23pt;">Level 2<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 236.14999999999998pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 108.18pt;"> in the fair value hierarchy.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 344.33000000000004pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 389.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic; font-weight: bold; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 55.23pt;">FX forwards.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.94pt;"></span><span id="i834e31ea7c554632aaef6456e8c4aa04"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic; font-weight: normal; left: 118.59pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.75pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.94pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 121.34pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 427.26pt;">FX forwards are agreements between two counterparties to exchange a pair of currencies at a set rate on a<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.94pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.6pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.94pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 401.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.16pt;">future date. Such contracts are used to convert the foreign currency risk to U.S. dollars to mitigate exposure to<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.52pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 413.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.26pt;">fluctuations in FX rates. The fair value adjustments are reported within net unrealized gain (loss) on financial<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.62pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 425.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 377.37pt;">instruments in the consolidated statements of operations. FX forwards are classified as <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 440.73pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 32.66pt;">Level 2<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 473.39pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 75.18pt;"> in the fair value<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.5699999999999pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 437.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 40.22pt;">hierarchy.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 103.58pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 461.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic; font-weight: bold; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 78.08pt;">Hedge accounting.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span><span id="ia21858eb3276407d9b1a7cee1183332a"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic; font-weight: bold; left: 141.44pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.87pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 144.31pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 404.33pt;">As a general rule, hedge accounting is permitted where the Company is exposed to a particular risk,<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.64pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 473.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.1pt;">such as interest rate risk, that causes changes in the fair value of an asset or liability or variability in the expected future<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.46pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 485.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 361.74pt;">cash flows of an existing asset, liability, or forecasted transaction that may affect earnings.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 509.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.22pt;">To qualify as an accounting hedge under the hedge accounting rules (versus an economic hedge where hedge accounting<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.58pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 521.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.18pt;">is not applied), a hedging relationship must be highly effective in offsetting the risk designated as being hedged. Cash<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.54pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 533.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.25pt;">flow hedges are used to hedge the exposure to the variability in cash flows from forecasted transactions, including the<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.61pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 545.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.17pt;">anticipated issuance of securitized debt obligations. ASC 815 requires that a forecasted transaction be identified as<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.53pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 557.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.22pt;">either: 1) a single transaction, or 2) a group of individual transactions that share the same risk exposures for which they<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.58pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 569.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.28pt;">are designated as being hedged. Hedges of forecasted transactions are considered cash flow hedges since the price is not<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.64pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 581.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 183.12pt;">fixed, hence involve variability of cash flows.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 605.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.27pt;">For qualifying cash flow hedges, the change in the fair value of the derivative (the hedging instrument) is recorded in<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.63pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 617.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.2pt;">other comprehensive income (loss) (&#8220;OCI&#8221;) and is reclassified out of OCI and into the consolidated statements of<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.56pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 629.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.27pt;">operations when the hedged cash flows affect earnings. These amounts are recognized consistent with the classification<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.63pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 641.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.21pt;">of the hedged item, primarily interest expense (for hedges of interest rate risk). If the hedge relationship is terminated,<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.5699999999999pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 653.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.25pt;">then the value of the derivative recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (&#8220;AOCI&#8221;) is recognized in<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.61pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 665.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.16pt;">earnings when the cash flows that were hedged affect earnings, so long as the forecasted transaction remains probable of<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.52pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 677.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 40.79pt;">occurring.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 104.15pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 701.16pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.13pt;">Hedge accounting is generally terminated at the debt issuance date because the Company is no longer exposed to cash<span style="display: inline-block; U.S. GAAP has a three-level hierarchy that prioritizes and ranks<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.64pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 99.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.21pt;">the level of market price observability used in measuring financial instruments at fair value. Market price observability is<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.5699999999999pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 111.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.23pt;">impacted by a number of factors, including the type of investment, the characteristics specific to the investment, and the<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.59pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 123.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.2pt;">state of the marketplace (including the existence and transparency of transactions between market participants). The<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.56pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 135.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.18pt;">Company&#8217;s valuation techniques for financial instruments use observable and unobservable inputs. Investments with<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.54pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 147.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.26pt;">readily available, actively quoted prices or for which fair value can be measured from actively quoted prices in an<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.62pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 159.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.15pt;">orderly market will generally have a higher degree of market price observability and a lesser degree of judgment used in<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.51pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 171.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.13pt;">measuring fair value. The hierarchy gives the highest priority to unadjusted quoted prices in active markets for identical<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.49pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 183.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.19pt;">assets or liabilities (Level&#160;1 measurements) and the lowest priority to unobservable inputs (Level&#160;3 measurements).<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.55pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 195.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 451.09pt;">Investments measured and reported at fair value are classified and disclosed into one of the following categories:<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 219.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 34.36pt;">Level 1 <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.94pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 97.72pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 450.81pt;">&#8212; Quoted prices (unadjusted) in active markets for identical assets and liabilities that the Company has the<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.94pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.53pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.94pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 231.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 66.28pt;">ability to access.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 129.64pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 255.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 32.78pt;">Level 2 <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.94pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 96.14pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 452.46pt;">&#8212; Pricing inputs are other than quoted prices in active markets, including, but not limited to, quoted prices for<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.94pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.6pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.94pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 267.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.23pt;">similar assets and liabilities in markets that are active, quoted prices for identical or similar assets or liabilities in markets<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.59pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 279.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.25pt;">that are not active, inputs other than quoted prices that are observable for the assets or liabilities (such as interest rates,<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.61pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 291.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.19pt;">yield curves, volatilities, prepayment speeds, loss severities, credit risks and default rates) or other market corroborated<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.55pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 303.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 26.93pt;">inputs.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 327.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 32.42pt;">Level 3 <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.94pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 95.78pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 452.75pt;">&#8212; One or more pricing inputs is significant to the overall valuation and unobservable. Significant unobservable<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.94pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.53pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.94pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 339.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.15pt;">inputs are based on the best information available in the circumstances, to the extent observable inputs are not available,<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.51pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 351.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.18pt;">including the Company&#8217;s own assumptions used in determining the fair value of financial instruments. Fair value for<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.54pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 363.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.22pt;">these investments is determined using valuation methodologies that consider a range of factors including, but not limited<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.58pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 375.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.25pt;">to, the price at which the investment was acquired, the nature of the investment, local market conditions, trading values<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.61pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 387.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.28pt;">on public exchanges for comparable securities, current and projected operating performance, and financing transactions<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.64pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 399.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.15pt;">subsequent to the acquisition of the investment. The inputs into the determination of fair value require significant<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.51pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 411.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 93.77pt;">management judgment.<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 435.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.22pt;">Valuation techniques of Level 3 investments vary by instrument type, but are generally based on an income, market or<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.58pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 447.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.23pt;">cost-based approach. The income approach predominantly considers discounted cash flows which is the measure of<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.59pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 459.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.23pt;">expected future cash flows in a default scenario, implied by the value of the underlying collateral, where applicable, and<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.59pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 471.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.27pt;">current performance whereas the market-based approach predominantly considers pull-through rates, industry multiples<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.63pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 483.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.16pt;">and the UPB. Fair value measurements of loans are sensitive to changes in assumptions regarding prepayments,<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.52pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 495.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.2pt;">probability of default, loss severity in the event of default, forecasts of home prices, and significant activity or<span style="display: inline-block; The Company uses derivative instruments to manage interest rate risk and conditions in the commercial<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.63pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 564.56pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.21pt;">mortgage market and, as such, views them as economic hedges. The amount of collateral<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.5pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 303.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.19pt;">pledged will typically exceed the amount of the borrowings (i.e., the haircut) such that the borrowings will be over-<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 315.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.25pt;">collateralized. As a result, the Company is exposed to the counterparty if, during the term of the repurchase agreement<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.61pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 327.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.22pt;">financing, a lender should default on its obligation and the Company is not able to recover its pledged assets. The<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.58pt; text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.15pt;">opportunistically disposing of them. Because non-performing LMM loans are short-term assets, the discount rates used<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.51pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.27pt;">for valuation are based on short-term market interest rates, which may not move in tandem with long-term market<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.63pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; height: 6.93pt;"></span><span id="i6594a93d09b0446d9f15cdca2b4d1e97"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 149.28pt; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 459.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.21pt;">are amortized against interest income. In general, an increase in prepayment rates accelerates the amortization of<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.5699999999999pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 471.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.27pt;">purchase premiums, thereby reducing the interest income earned on the assets. Conversely, discounts on such assets are<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.63pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 10pt; position: var(--position); text-align: justify; text-align-last: var(--justify); top: 483.36pt; width: 612pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 63.36pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 485.27pt;">accreted into interest income. In general, an increase in prepayment rates accelerates the accretion of purchase discounts,<span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; left: 548.63pt; position: var(--position); text-decoration: none; white-space: pre; width: 2.5pt;"> <span style="display: inline-block; height: 6.93pt;"></span></span></div><div style="font-size: 12pt;
